newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves $60 million loan for Latvia.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $60 million loan for Latvia.

text.p: The World Bank on Thursday approved a $60 million loan to Latvia to support an economic reform plan aimed at promoting private sector development and improving management of public resources.

"To revitalise the economy, the government of Latvia has developed an economic reform programme that will maintain economic stability, continue the progress made in the financial sector, while speeding up structural reforms and making further reductions in the fiscal deficit," the bank said in a statement.
The funds would be disbursed within the next three years, the bank said, noting that the first tranche of $20 million would be available immediately.
Latvia has received a total of $210 million for seven projects since it joined the World Bank in 1992.
